yaya.story.label: StoryTeller
yaya.story.desc: Adds a Story mode workflow: an author agent researches, builds the world and asks characters on its own to tell an interactive story (pick it in the workflow menu once enabled)
yaya.story.wf_desc: Interactive story: the author decides whether to research, build the world, ask characters or just write; a director suggests pacing and a chronicler keeps the bible; you decide what the protagonist does
yaya.story.cfg.style_desc: e.g. “terse film noir” or “light, funny fairy tale”; empty = fit the genre
yaya.story.cfg.character_agents_desc: The author may ask character sub-agents for their intent and lines; off is faster and cheaper but characters sound more like the narrator
yaya.story.cfg.chapter_beats_desc: The director paces each chapter over this many beats: tension climaxes near the end, then a new chapter begins
yaya.story.cfg.fate_desc: Roll a d20 each turn as a suggestion to the author: occasional complications, luck or twists keep the story off the rails
yaya.story.card.title: Story state
yaya.story.bible.action_desc: World, characters and threads of story mode
yaya.story.bible.title: Story bible
yaya.story.bible.empty: No story bible on this branch yet: pick “Story mode” in the workflow menu and describe the story you want.
yaya.story.cfg.tools_desc: Lets the author look things up before writing; the tools themselves are enabled on the plugins page (e.g. web search)
yaya.story.cfg.tool_rounds_desc: How many rounds the author may spend researching and asking characters before it must write
yaya.story.step.author: Author: plan and research
